free_tier.stated: Models with pricing.is_free are 0 RUB per 1M tokens and work without a deposit (even at a 0 RUB balance), with a limit of 100 requests per user per day in a rolling 24-hour window.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

tooling: an OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible key (sk-gw-) created in the account
chaining: the 100-requests-per-day shared free limit and provider-side 429s are the scarce links

limits.value: 100 free requests per user per day, rolling 24h window, shared across all free models

identity_cost.detail: a human creates the key in the account cabinet; free models work with a 0 RUB balance and no deposit

reliability_note: provider-side free pools are shared and can return 429 even before the 100/day limit is reached

evidence.proved: free models need no deposit and are limited to 100 requests per user per day
